decisions.reason: Despite slack, the service is close to core but undifferentiated and shows no positive results, leaving it below aspirations and triggering problemistic search that reallocates resources to more promising areas.
The reported adoption is a positive result above aspirations in a core connectivity area, so slack and strategic fit make dropping highly unlikely.
The dedicated page signals investment and the product builds on established optical capabilities, so slack and expansion support keeping this strategic service.
Although only mentioned and results are uncertain, the portal is low-cost and supportive of voice services, and current slack allows continued monitoring.
Direct voice connection remains close to the existing voice business and may retain customers, but weak visibility warrants elevated drop risk; slack still allows keeping it for now.
